skill.summary: Explains Monero's privacy features including ring signatures, stealth addresses, RingCT, Kovri/I2P, Dandelion++, and Bulletproofs.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release explaining Monero's core privacy technologies.
- Covers ring signatures, stealth addresses, RingCT, Kovri/I2P integration, Dandelion++, and Bulletproofs.
- Provides comparison table with Bitcoin and Zcash privacy features.
- Lists real-world privacy use cases and outlines notable limitations.
- Includes further reading links and contribution information.
